description: Run named Nagios plugins on this host and return one JSON document: per check the state, summary, parsed performance data and long output, and the worst state overall. The caller names the checks; this host's nagios-checks.conf says which plugin and arguments each name runs, so no plugin arguments are accepted. Exit code is the overall state: 0 OK, 1 WARNING, 2 CRITICAL, 3 UNKNOWN (also any wrapper error). Makes no changes of its own.

checks.description: Names of the checks to run, as configured on the agent (see list). Run in the order given.

list.description: List the check names this host offers instead of running any.

all.description: Run every check configured on this host.
